characters.name: Eldrin Vane
characters.description: A gaunt, dark-haired sellsword with a silver scar bisecting his left eyebrow.
characters.motivation: Find the person who murdered his sister
characters.secret: His sister's death was his own fault

relationships.description: Owes a life-debt to the healer who saved him

characters.name: Mira Thorn
characters.description: An elderly woman with gentle hands and knowing eyes.
characters.motivation: Protect the innocent from the Salt Priests

relationships.description: Saved Eldrin from a Salt Wraith

characters.name: High Priest Malachar
characters.description: A tall figure in white robes, face hidden behind a salt-crusted mask.
characters.secret: He was once a healer who lost his family to the Godfall

characters.name: Kael the Wanderer
characters.description: A hooded figure who walks the salt flats without fear.
characters.secret: They are the last worshipper of the River god

locations.name: The Ashen Marches
locations.description: A vast salt flat where nothing grows. Ghost-lights dance on the horizon at night.
secrets: The dead god's heart still beats somewhere beneath the salt

locations.name: The Salt Temple
locations.description: A cathedral carved from compressed salt, glowing faintly from within.
secrets: The High Priest's chambers contain a map to the God-Heart

locations.name: Thorn's Hearth
locations.description: A small settlement built around a natural spring — the only fresh water for miles.

factions.name: The Salt Priests
factions.description: Ascetics who believe the dead god will rise again.
factions.public_face: Harmless monks who provide burial rites

factions.name: The Spring Wardens
factions.description: Protectors of the few remaining water sources in the Marches.
factions.goal: Preserve life in the salt wastes

creatures.name: Salt Wraith
creatures.description: A translucent humanoid shape that forms from salt-storms. Screams with its last victim's voice.
creatures.behavior: Hunts by sound. Stand still and silent, and it passes.
creatures.origin: Souls trapped in the dead god's final breath

creatures.name: Salt-Hound
creatures.description: A wolf-like creature with crystalline fur that blends into the salt flats.
creatures.origin: Native wildlife mutated by divine salt exposure

artifacts.name: The God-Heart Shard
artifacts.description: A fist-sized chunk of black crystal that pulses with faint red light. Warm to the touch.
artifacts.origin: A fragment of the dead god's heart, ejected when it fell
artifacts.power: Can kill anything mortal with a single touch — but the wielder ages one year per use
artifacts.curse: Prolonged proximity causes dreams of the god's dying moments

events.name: The Godfall
events.description: Three thousand years ago, a god of salt and silence was cast down from the heavens. Its body shattered across the Marches.
events.consequence: The Marches are magically unstable. Magic works unpredictably. The dead sometimes rise.

magic.source: Divine blood — consuming salt infused with the god's essence fuels spells.
rules: Magic always exacts a physical toll: exhaustion, aging, or injury
No spell can create something from nothing — only transform or destroy
Mind-reading and prophecy are impossible — the god's death broke linear time
costs: Physical deterioration proportional to spell power
magic.limitations: Magic fails entirely within a mile of running water — the god's antithesis

politics.power_structure: No central authority. Warlords, cults, and settlements compete for resources.

conflicts.name: The Salt War
conflicts.stakes: Control of the richest salt veins — and the divine essence within them

gods.name: The Silent One
gods.worship: The Salt Priests venerate its corpse and seek resurrection

gods.name: The River
gods.worship: Few followers remain. The River cannot enter the Marches.

religion.afterlife: The dead god's corpse is a purgatory. Souls linger in the salt until they fade.
